familyDefinition: High-level error categories may repeat. A family is the syntactic frame, participant/temporal/quantity relation and contextual ambiguity operation. Mere changes of names, lemmas, number spelling, word order paraphrase or surface synonyms do not create a new family. Reviewer records the specific structural distinction.

corpusSeparation.development: All public105 matrix, curriculum, past API failures/responses and current synthetic regression cases are exposed; use for debugging only.
corpusSeparation.calibration: 12 fabricated witness outputs exercise judge behavior, separately labeled; never count them as pilot/confirmation predictions. T14 prepares, T25 measures.
corpusSeparation.pilot: T24 authors 60 new inputs only after source/policy freeze. Compare against all known development/calibration families; same-author novelty is not independent authorship.
corpusSeparation.confirmatory: T35 creates a newly sealed set after pilot decisions. No family shared with development/calibration/pilot; approved N/r and risk decision T34 required. Never reuse exposed pilot as confirmation.

automatic: Exact input + target + context normalized for whitespace and casing
Input token fingerprint ignoring trivial punctuation/number spelling; only a warning, not a semantic uniqueness proof
requiredManual: Check semantic equivalence and simple lexical replacement against exposed examples

changeControl: Record source, prompt, parser, curriculum, target, model, options, rubric and exposure hashes at freeze.
Any source/rubric/case/gold change after observing outputs invalidates that run for confirmatory claims; retain raw results and create a new version plus newly sealed families.
No replacement of failed/missing requests to improve the denominator. T18/T21 account for every frozen slot.
60 intentionally stratified cases and repeated outputs are diagnostic only; do not treat them as independent service-wide Bernoulli observations. T34 sets confirmation uncertainty/risk/sample design.
